comment: Grader v2 (plan v2 §7). Every change here is a reviewed PR; the agent never edits this file.
entry_rule: Close of the decision day if decided before entry_cutoff_ist on a trading day, else the next trading day's close. Exit = close h trading days after entry.
price_source: yahoo_adjusted (auto_adjust=True). Owner decision 2026-10-02: bhavcopy + corporate-action adjuster and sector benchmarks move to Phase 3.

costs.comment: NSE cash delivery, from docs/plans/stats_reference.py (researched 2026-10-01). Applied to .NS instruments only; indices, FX and commodities carry no cost model yet and are reported gross.

liquidity_buckets_cr.comment: 20-day median daily turnover (Close x Volume) before entry, in Rs crore. Unknown turnover is costed as small (conservative).

b0_default_direction.comment: B0 = take every flag in its kind's default direction. null = graded but left out of B0 (owner decision Q5, 2026-10-02). 'hint' = the flag's own direction_hint. 'typed_announcement' = typed_announcement_directions, only while that table is active.

typed_announcement_directions.status: APPROVED by the owner 2026-10-02 as proposed. Keys are NSE announcement categories (flag extra.desc) the scouts currently flag.

notes.Action(s) taken or orders passed: Covers both regulatory penalties and favourable court/tribunal orders; no honest default.
notes.Acquisition: Acquirer-side reaction is mixed in the literature; no honest default.
notes.Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulatio: Mostly the company forwarding holder disclosures already flagged via SAST; would double-count.
notes.not_yet_scouted: Auditor resignation (proposed default DOWN) is not an announcement category the scouts flag today; adding it is a scout change.

excluded_calls.reason: forced by the old step 3b (any market view with p >= 0.55 had to be recorded as a call); not the agent's judgment
